# Creative Bloq

> > Creative Bloq is a leading online magazine for designers, artists, and creatives covering design, branding, digital art, concept art, AI ethics, and creative industry news.

Creative Bloq provides professional insights, tutorials, reviews, and commentary on all aspects of creative work, from concept art techniques by ILM artists to branding strategy lessons, design controversies, and technology reviews for creative professionals.

## Key Topics

- Branding and brand experience
- Concept art and visual development
- AI ethics and creative industry impact
- Logo design and visual identity
- Industrial Light & Magic (ILM)
- Digital illustration and art direction
- Adobe Creative Suite (InDesign, Photoshop)
- Apple design and technology
- VFX and film production
- Advertising and marketing design
- Animation and motion graphics
- Design plagiarism and copyright
- Creative workspace and equipment
- Game design and visual development
- Typography and print design

- [The ultimate logo quiz: think you know your 1930s logos?](https://www.creativebloq.com/design/logos-icons/the-ultimate-logo-quiz-think-you-know-your-1930s-logos): Interactive 1930s logo trivia quiz featuring Audi, Warner Bros, Caterpillar
